description: Mandatory Red tests written BEFORE implementation. All run against the live GitHub Pages deployment. 22 of 48 tests FAILED, capturing the gap between current state and target architecture.

architecture.note: R001 fails because current nav has 18 peer-level links, not 5 task-oriented sections. R006 passes because the corpus map links to the analyzer indirectly (via #explorer).

truthfulness.note: R009 and R021 both fail because the standalone analyzer still uses 'GAN' label (4 occurrences) for phrase injection + regex mutation. GAN gate: 0/8 criteria met.

ad_assessment.note: R013-R015 fail because no 'Analyze an Ad' workspace exists in the dashboard. R018-R019 fail because no privacy notice about no-retention/no-training is present.

adversarial_lab.note: R021 (GAN gate) is counted under truthfulness. The adversarial lab tests pass because the dashboard already documents challenge rounds and the spec's defensive boundary is respected.

tutorial.note: R025-R028 fail because no tutorial system exists. R029 passes vacuously (the word 'keyboard' appears in the dashboard).

navigation_state.note: R030 fails because deep links to #mission-control, #analyze, #explore, #models-lab, #guide don't resolve (these sections don't exist yet in the current architecture).

model_integrity.note: Model integrity tests pass because the dashboard already documents brand leakage, Brier/ECE, and F1/precision/recall.

performance_accessibility.note: R036 fails (13.4 MB vs 150 KB budget). R037 fails (12.38 MB embedded report-data JSON). R040 fails (768px tablet portrait overflow). R043 fails (2/4 inputs lack aria-label).

contextual_assistant.note: R044 fails because no 'Ask AdIntel' assistant exists. R046 fails because no refusal notice exists. R045 passes because 'evidence' and 'cite' appear in the methodology section.

indicator_dictionary.note: Both fail because no canonical indicator dictionary exists.
